messages:
kari: Quick note 1 MistralHealth wants to POC mistral-tex-40b:q7 on Dedicated. asks: catalog entry, variant compatibility (q7), KV cache memory behavior, EKM/KMS support, and a POC price estimate. can someone triage?

dan_p: who is the contact and what workload shape?

kari: contact is erin@mistralhealth.ai. workload is clinical summarization + embedding store: many medium requests, context ~9k tokens, heavy KV reuse.

yusuf: q7 (mixed 7-bit quant) is nonstandard for us; need a compatibility check. i'll run a scan against our a100-80 fleet. kicking it off now.

ops-bot: presales scan started job=mistral_q7_scan_202. checks: kv-cache, kernel-compat, tokenization, embedding-consistency. ETA ~6m.

dan_p: ballpark pricing delta q7 vs fp16 on Dedicated? any additional setup for EKM?

yusuf: quick estimate: q7 runtime compute -20% vs fp16; KV cache kept in fp16 adds ~+13% memory. EKM is a one-time ops integration (no runtime cost) but schedule adds 2-4 business days depending on vendor.

ops-bot: scan complete. job=mistral_q7_scan_202. summary: kernel fallback required on older driver versions (shim available), KV-cache overhead +13.1%, embedding variance within tolerance, tokenization drift observed in 0.22% of prompts (edge case). full report: https://s3.redwood.ai/presales/mistral_q7_scan_202/report.html

yusuf: not blocking but two items: 1) tokenization drift repro included below, 2) ops needs to review EKM runbook for their HSM vendor (they mentioned Thales).

kari: erin asked specifically about EKM/HSM and audit logs. security take?

sec-bot: draft security response: "Dedicated supports customer-managed keys via supported KMS. For external key managers/HSM (EKM), we require an ops integration runbook and a short validation window; we can enable audit logging to the customer's SIEM. Additional compliance artifacts available under enterprise contract." please review.

dan_p: ops timeline for validation + EKM integration?

yusuf: if they only need KMS, 1-2 business days. For Thales HSM EKM integration expect 3-6 business days (coordination with vendor + rotation tests).

billing-bot: POC pricing: sketching two-line quote: Dedicated compute (q7 discounted runtime) and one-time EKM integration fee. i'll produce a draft by EOD tomorrow after confirming memory impact.

kari: can someone paste the minimal failing prompt so Erin can validate locally?

yusuf: here you go:

```
# minimal repro for tokenization drift (~0.22% of cases)
Prompt: "Summarize: \"Patient notes: 'BP 120/80; follow-up in 2w'\" with clinical emojis \\u2695\\uFE0F"
```

yusuf: reproduces a 1-token offset on q7 in a small sample. i have a fix branch ready if they need strict parity.

dan_p: assigning follow-ups: yusuf = token-fix branch + ops runbook, kari = customer comms, billing-bot = draft quote, sec-bot = finalize security Q draft.

kari: i'll email erin with the report link and timelines. thanks team :thumbsup:

dan_p: thanks all. closing for now, will reopen if MistralHealth requests deeper perf traces.
